messages:
ana_cs: Heads up — QBR next Wed 10am PT with Meridian. Can we lock slide owners and top 3 renewal risks by EOD Friday?

jordan_pm: I can own the account health slide. Will pull adoption metrics today.

micah_se: I’ll take onboarding status + open enablement requests. Quick ask: do we want a short demo or just screenshots?

ana_cs: @micah_se short demo would be great if we can keep it under 3 mins. Otherwise screenshots + 1-liner per feature.

devon_eng: I can make a condensed demo vid (30–45s) of the integration flow. ETA Friday noon.

jordan_pm: For renewal risks — early warning flags: spike in error rates last week, two stalled playbooks, and CSAT down 0.6. I’ll draft risk descriptions.

sam_exec: Good. For exec slide, I want 2 bullets: impact and proposed mitigation (owner + ETA). Keep it very high level.

micah_se: Sounds good. I’ll add owners. Also capturing ask list for enablement: 1) refresher webinar, 2) new sample prompts doc, 3) integration runbook.

ana_cs: Can someone add the cost/usage trend? Finance requested a single chart. @devon_eng?

devon_eng: I’ll generate a one-panel usage trend and token cost delta. Will post link when done.

cs_bot: Reminder: QBR folder created at https://redwood.app/qbr/meridian-5254321987.

jordan_pm: Draft slide assignments: Account health (jordan_pm), Onboarding status (micah_se), Risks & mitigations (jordan_pm + ana_cs), Exec ask slide (sam_exec), Demo (devon_eng).

ana_cs: Can we have a one-page appendix with open action items and owners? Execs sometimes ask for it.

sam_exec: Yes — good call. Keep it 1 page with status (Open/In progress/Done).

micah_se: Quick sync ask — can we meet 30m Monday to review slides before final? 11am PT works for me.

jordan_pm: 11am PT Monday works. I’ll create a calendar invite and attach draft deck.

devon_eng: Uploaded demo vid to the QBR folder. filename: integration-demo-45s.mp4.

ana_cs: Thanks — I'll review and add timestamps to cue the 45s segment.

jordan_pm: Shared initial deck with skeleton and placeholder charts: https://redwood.app/qbr/meridian-5254321987/deck-v1.pptx. Please add content directly or leave comments.

micah_se: Added onboarding slides and enablement ask list. Left comments on playbook status chart.

ana_cs: Two outstanding asks before Monday: 1) finalize renewal risk language, 2) confirm demo clip start time. Can owners confirm by Friday EOD?

jordan_pm: I’ll finalize risk language by Friday 3pm PT.

devon_eng: Demo start time confirmed — clip begins at 0:12.

sam_exec: Great. If everything is green by Monday 11am we’re set for Wed execs. Thanks y’all. :rocket:

cs_bot: Action item created: #1427 — "Finalize Meridian QBR deck" assigned to jordan_pm, micah_se, devon_eng. Due: 5254325400.
